It’s been going on for maybe eight or nine months now. At first I thought it was just work stress, but it’s gotten…strange.

I’m a sound engineer, so I’m used to listening for tiny things, but lately I’m convinced people are listening for me. I feel like there are mics hidden in my flat, or that the studio cameras are on even when the red light’s off. When I’m walking home, I’m sure cars are slowing down to watch me, like someone’s tracking where I go. I’ve tried checking for devices, unplugging everything, but it still feels like I’m being monitored, maybe by the company or some government thing.

On top of that, my head just isn’t right. Sometimes when I’m in the control room, I’ll hear someone say my name or a short phrase, clear as day, but no one’s on the talkback. I’ll ask who called me and everyone just looks at me. My thoughts feel messy, like they get tangled mid-sentence, and I lose my train of thought. It’s getting harder to follow conversations with clients or even mix a track straight through.
